decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page and has been on the market for two years, it fits the core natural facial care offer, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The cleansing milk is a low-cost staple that rounds out the facial routine and uses existing suppliers and in-house production, so without evidence of underperformance the firm keeps carrying it.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and overlaps somewhat with the cleansing milk, but in a growing industry and with no sign of a performance gap, the firm uses its slack to give it time to prove itself rather than dropping it early.
